title: Totemizer
description: Change the texture of your totem to one of 100, with a single click! And much more!
body:
You will also need to install Fabric Api and Mod Menu.

1)The ability to change the totem texture directly through hotkeys or through the mod menu, with 99 totem textures available.

2)Adjust the size of the totem in your hand and when it is activated, and set how many seconds the totem will be displayed when activated.

3)The ability to disable the totem activation sound.

4)The ability to set custom totem particles and customize the colors, size, time, and more.
The ability to add up to 7 different colors to the totem particles.

5)Customizable text warning if the totem is in the inventory (but not in one of the hands). (You can customize the size and location of the warning, as well as enter your own text).

6)Customizable timer before the warning (if you set 5 seconds, then after 5 seconds as you no longer have the totem in your hand, the warning will appear).

7)Totem bar - a bar that displays the number of totems in the inventory. (Above the hunger bar)

8)Default hot buttons(can be configured in the management menu):

➡️ - change the texture to the following

⬅️ - change the texture to the previous one

⬆️- change the texture to a random one

⬇️- change the texture to the previous one if it was switched randomly 

" - Enable the automatic totem switching mode every 10 seconds (default time, but can be adjusted)

] - apply your favorite texture (which you need to select in the GUI texture settings via the mod menu) 


9)When switching textures, the texture number is displayed by default, which can be disabled in the settings

You can configure the keys in the Control menu - Key Assignment. And the settings of the mod itself in the Mods tab, and click on the mod icon.
